evidence.statement: XMEAS(7) Reactor Pressure [kPa gauge] 경보(높음/낮음) 대응. [코드] 반응기 압력을 읽는 루프는 없다. 이 구조에서 압력에 닿는 조작은 퍼지 경로 (CONTRL19 → SETPT(6) → CONTRL6 → XMV(6)) 와 분리기 압력 오버라이드뿐이다. [코드] 퍼지 B 목표를 낮추면 CONTRL19 가 SETPT(6)(퍼지 유량 목표)을 올린다(simulate_purge_b_cases 표). [가설] 퍼지가 늘면 반응기 압력이 내려간다. 시뮬레이션으로 확인한다. [문헌] 반응기 압력 셧다운 한계는 Downs & Vogel 표 6 의 3000 kPa(g). → check_purge_override 후 simulate_purge_b_cases.

evidence.statement: The shutdown limits (3000 kPa g, 175 °C and the liquid volumes) are the benchmark's own teaching values, not those of any real plant, where they come from the vessel design code and the safety-instrumented-system study (IEC 61511).
evidence.supporting_quote:
The plant equations, constants, noise levels, analyzer periods and shutdown limits are those of
 the public code, unchanged. The shutdown limits (3000 kPa g, 175 °C and the liquid volumes)
 are the benchmark's own teaching values, not those of any real plant, where they come from
 the vessel design code and the safety-instrumented-system study (IEC 61511).
 Random numbers come from two seeded generators (disturbance walks and measurement
 noise apart, as in the 2015 revision of Bathelt, Ricker and Jelali) instead of the original single
 generator, so a run replays bit for bit after Reset. Individual noise realizations therefore differ
 from the original code's, while their statistics (the sum of twelve uniform deviates, scaled to the
 published standard deviations) are the same.
 The analyzers fire on a step count (every 360 and 900 one-second steps) rather than on a
 floating-point clock. This changes no sample time.

evidence.statement: SETPT(19) 를 현재값 대비 ±0.5~±2.0 mol% 바꾼 case 를 hold(SOP 단독)와 같은 조건에서 시뮬레이션한다. [코드] ΔSETPT(6)=K19·ΔSETPT(19)·100/26/100: −1 mol% → SETPT(6) +0.2133 kscmh, XMV(6) +26.03%p 즉시. 오차가 남으면 360 s 마다 SETPT(6) +0.01212. XMV(6)+즉시 변화가 0~100% 밖이면 시험하지 않는다. 오버라이드 래치 중에는 CONTRL6 이 돌지 않아 효과가 없다.
